easy.statement: Given an array of integers, find the maximum product of any two elements.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1). Handle negative numbers.

easy.statement: Given a string, determine if it is a valid palindrome considering only alphanumeric characters.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1). Ignore case differences.

easy.statement: Given two sorted arrays, merge them into one sorted array without extra space proportional to their combined length.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n+m), Space: O(1) extra. Handle empty arrays.

easy.statement: Implement a function to check if two strings are anagrams of each other.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1) with fixed alphabet. Handle unicode and case sensitivity.

easy.statement: Find the first non-repeating character in a string and return its index.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1). Return -1 if no unique character exists.

easy.statement: Given a sorted array, remove duplicates in-place and return the new length.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1). Modify array in-place.

easy.statement: Implement a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time.
easy.requirements: All operations must be O(1). Handle empty stack edge case.

easy.statement: Given a linked list, determine if it has a cycle.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1). Use Floyd's cycle detection.

easy.statement: Given an integer array, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
easy.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(1). Handle all-negative arrays.

easy.statement: Implement binary search on a sorted array. Return the index of the target or -1.
easy.requirements: Time: O(log n), Space: O(1). Handle empty array and single element.

medium.statement: Design an LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache with get() and put() operations.
medium.requirements: Both operations should be O(1). Support custom capacity.

medium.statement: Given a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes values grouped by level.
medium.requirements: Time: O(n). Handle empty trees and single-node trees.

medium.statement: Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters in a given string.
medium.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(min(n, alphabet)). Handle empty strings.

medium.statement: Given an array of integers and a target, return indices of two numbers that add up to the target.
medium.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(n). Each input has exactly one solution.

medium.statement: Implement a function to serialize and deserialize a binary tree.
medium.requirements: Time: O(n) for both operations. Handle null nodes.

medium.statement: Given an m×n grid of 0s and 1s, count the number of distinct islands.
medium.requirements: Time: O(m*n). Handle single-cell islands and diagonal adjacency.

medium.statement: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array without fully sorting it.
medium.requirements: Average Time: O(n). Handle duplicates and single-element arrays.

medium.statement: Given a list of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals.
medium.requirements: Time: O(n log n). Handle edge cases: single interval, no overlap, full overlap.

medium.statement: Implement a trie (prefix tree) with insert, search, and startsWith methods.
medium.requirements: Insert and search in O(word length). Space efficient for shared prefixes.

medium.statement: Given a matrix, find the longest increasing path. You can move up, down, left, or right.
medium.requirements: Time: O(m*n). Use memoization. Handle single-cell matrix.

medium.statement: Design a data structure that supports insert, delete, and getRandom in O(1) average time.
medium.requirements: All three operations O(1) average. Handle duplicates.

medium.statement: Given a string containing just the characters '(' and ')', find the length of the longest valid parentheses substring.
medium.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(n). Handle nested and sequential valid pairs.

hard.statement: Implement a data structure for Median Finder that supports addNum() and findMedian() operations.
hard.requirements: addNum() in O(log n), findMedian() in O(1). Support continuous stream.

hard.statement: Given a matrix of 0s and 1s, find the largest rectangle containing only 1s and return its area.
hard.requirements: Time: O(rows * cols), Space: O(cols). Handle edge cases.

hard.statement: Implement a trie-based autocomplete system that returns the top 3 suggestions for each character typed.
hard.requirements: Insert in O(word length), search in O(prefix length + k). Rank by frequency.

hard.statement: Given n buildings on a skyline, compute the outline of the combined silhouette.
hard.requirements: Time: O(n log n). Handle overlapping and adjacent buildings.

hard.statement: Implement a solution to the word ladder problem: find the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord.
hard.requirements: Time: O(M² × N) where M=word length, N=list size. Return 0 if no path.

hard.statement: Design a data structure that supports adding words and searching with wildcards (. matches any letter).
hard.requirements: Add in O(word length). Search in O(26^dots × word length) worst case.

hard.statement: Given a stream of integers, find the sliding window median for each window of size k.
hard.requirements: Time: O(n log k) per element. Handle even and odd window sizes.

hard.statement: Solve the N-Queens problem: place N queens on an N×N board so no two queens threaten each other.
hard.requirements: Return all distinct solutions. Time: O(N!). Handle N=1 to N=9.

hard.statement: Given an alien language with a sorted dictionary of words, derive the order of characters in the alien alphabet.
hard.requirements: Time: O(C) where C=total chars. Handle invalid inputs.

hard.statement: Find the minimum window substring in S that contains all characters of T.
hard.requirements: Time: O(n), Space: O(k) where k=unique chars in T. Handle duplicates in T.

easy.statement: Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly.
easy.requirements: Handle 100M URLs, support custom aliases, track click analytics.

easy.statement: Design a paste bin service that allows users to share text snippets via unique links.
easy.requirements: Support expiry, access control (public/private), and 10K concurrent users.

easy.statement: Design a task queue system that processes background jobs reliably.
easy.requirements: Support retries, priority, and dead-letter queues. At-least-once delivery.

easy.statement: Design a rate limiter for an API gateway.
easy.requirements: Support per-user and per-endpoint limits. Handle distributed deployment.

easy.statement: Design a file storage service like Google Drive for personal use.
easy.requirements: Support upload, download, versioning, and sharing. 50GB per user.

easy.statement: Design a logging and monitoring system for a microservices architecture.
easy.requirements: Centralized log aggregation, alerting, and dashboard. Handle 1M logs/min.

easy.statement: Design an online bookstore with search, recommendations, and checkout.
easy.requirements: Support 100K products, full-text search, and payment integration.

easy.statement: Design a simple content delivery network (CDN) for static assets.
easy.requirements: Cache invalidation, edge nodes in 3 regions, 99.9% uptime.

medium.statement: Design a real-time chat application supporting 1-on-1 and group messaging.
medium.requirements: Support 1M concurrent users, message delivery guarantees, and read receipts.

medium.statement: Design a notification system that delivers push, email, and SMS notifications.
medium.requirements: Support rate limiting, user preferences, and 10M notifications/day.

medium.statement: Design a ride-sharing service like Uber for matching drivers and riders.
medium.requirements: Geo-proximity matching, surge pricing, and ETA calculation.

medium.statement: Design a web crawler that can index 1 billion pages.
medium.requirements: Handle politeness policies, deduplication, and distributed crawling.

medium.statement: Design an e-commerce platform's order management system.
medium.requirements: Handle inventory, payments, fulfillment, returns. 100K orders/day.

medium.statement: Design a location-based restaurant recommendation service.
medium.requirements: Support geo-search, ratings, reviews, and 10M active users.

medium.statement: Design a collaborative document editor like Google Docs.
medium.requirements: Real-time sync, conflict resolution (OT/CRDT), and offline support.

medium.statement: Design a payment processing system that handles card transactions.
medium.requirements: PCI compliance, idempotency, retry logic, and 50K TPS.

hard.statement: Design a distributed video streaming platform similar to YouTube.
hard.requirements: Adaptive bitrate, CDN distribution, 100M DAU, and live streaming.

hard.statement: Design a global-scale social media news feed with real-time updates.
hard.requirements: Fan-out, ranking, 500M users, and sub-second latency.

hard.statement: Design a distributed search engine that indexes and queries billions of web pages.
hard.requirements: Relevance ranking, real-time indexing, and horizontal scaling.

hard.statement: Design a stock trading platform with real-time market data and order matching.
hard.requirements: Sub-millisecond matching, ACID transactions, and regulatory compliance.

hard.statement: Design a multi-region database with strong consistency guarantees.
hard.requirements: Cross-region replication, leader election, and linearizable reads.

hard.statement: Design a real-time multiplayer game backend supporting 1M concurrent players.
hard.requirements: State sync, lag compensation, matchmaking, and anti-cheat.
